user.title: Hades Household — Vault Credentials
user.description: Optional. Configure Hades Vault so future modules can fetch short-lived API tokens instead of hardcoded keys. Leave blank to skip — you can set this up later via Configure.

calendars.title: Add a Calendar (Optional)
calendars.description: You can skip this and add calendars later via the Configure button.

chores.title: Chores Webhook (Optional)
chores.description: Paste a random string (e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 8`) to enable per-person chores sensors, updated by POSTing to /api/webhook/<this value>. Treat it like a password. Leave blank to skip.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the host and try again.

abort.already_configured: Hades Household Integration is already configured.

add_ical.title: Add iCal Calendar
add_ical.description: Paste a public or private .ics URL.

add_caldav.title: Add CalDAV Calendar (iCloud)
add_caldav.description: Use your Apple ID and an app-specific password from appleid.apple.com.

update_chores.title: Update Chores Webhook ID
update_chores.description: Blank disables the chores feature and removes the webhook.
